overview: Hybrid-only minivan since the 4th-gen launched for MY2021 — Toyota's only minivan and the only mass-market hybrid van in the US until Chrysler Pacifica Hybrid PHEV. 2.5L 4-cyl + electric motors, 245 hp combined, 36 mpg combined, available FWD or e-AWD. Trims: LE, XLE, XSE, Limited, Platinum, Woodland Edition. Source: https://www.toyota.com/sienna/
